sloka: एवमुक्त्वा गताः सर्वे ऋषयस्ते यथागतम् ।राघवश्च तमेवार्थं चिन्तयामास विस्मितः ।। ७.३६.६२ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve ṛṣayaste yathāgatam ।rāghavaśca tamevārthaṁ cintayāmāsa vismitaḥ ।। 7.36.62 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, all those sages departed the way they had come, and Rama, astonished, pondered over that very matter.
